تكتشفون (form VIII)
# تَكْتَشِفُونَ (taktašifūna) /tak.ta.ʃi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# تُكْتَشَفُونَ (tuktašafūna) /tuk.ta.ʃa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
